[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Rigel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Imperial Conquest Consolidation Corps]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="OPB" />

==Biography==
Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], he was looking for the best [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], [[Agent/Legends|agents]], and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|guns-for-hire]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in order to defeat the [[Balmorran resistance]]. He sent an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] individual to meet with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Davrill]].<ref name="OPB" />
